body.detail: Vendor vnd-4f257ad6 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

evidence.expected: 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 1: no purchase order can be created for an inactive vendor.
evidence.reason: Refused with 400 and rule inactive_vendor_gate. Vendor vnd-4f257ad6 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

body.detail: Cannot receive 20 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 4, already received 0.

evidence.expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit. docs/API.md Business rules row 2: received quantity never exceeds ordered quantity.
evidence.reason: Refused with 400 and rule receive_quantity_limit. Cannot receive 20 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 4, already received 0.

evidence.expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: no tolerance, including one cent.
evidence.reason: Accepted with status 201 and total_amount 10.01 after 1 unit was received at 10.00. Business rules row 3 says invoiced value never exceeds what was received, and there is no tolerance. A fresh replay returned 201 as well.

body.detail: Invoice inv-93068080 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

evidence.expected: 400 with rule three_way_match_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 4: an invoice cannot be approved until it passed the 3-way match.
evidence.reason: Refused with 400 and rule three_way_match_gate. Invoice inv-93068080 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

evidence.expected: 200 and partial_receipt true. docs/API.md Business rules row 5: the flag is true when any line of the PO is not fully received.
evidence.reason: Match returned 200 with partial_receipt false. Ordered value is 70 and received value is 50, so a line is not fully received. Business rules row 5 requires partial_receipt true. A fresh replay returned the same false flag.

evidence.expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. docs/API.md Business rules row 6: invoice numbers are compared ignoring upper or lower case. The second invoice quantity still fits the receipt.
evidence.reason: Accepted with status 201 and total_amount 20. The number differs from the vendor's existing invoice number only by letter case. Business rules row 6 treats those as the same number. A fresh replay returned 201 as well.

evidence.expected: 200, gl_entry.balanced true, and total debits equal total credits equal 11.75. docs/API.md Business rules row 7 and Basics (money rounded to cents).
evidence.reason: Debits and credits both equal 11.75 and balanced is true.

evidence.reason: Refused with 400 and rule invoice_line_validation. SKU PLY-12-4X8 is not on the purchase order.

evidence.reason: Refused with 400 and rule workflow_gate. Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-ad2528a2 is draft.

evidence.expected: 200 and open_ap_liability 42.50, listing only the two approved invoice ids. docs/API.md Business rules row 11: exposure is the sum of total_amount over approved invoices.
evidence.reason: open_ap_liability 42.5 equals the approved invoice total 42.50, and approved_invoices lists only those invoices.

evidence.expected: 201. docs/API.md Purchase orders allows unit_price from 0 to 100,000, so zero is a valid price.
evidence.reason: Draft purchase order was created with unit_price 0, which is inside the documented range of 0 to 100,000.

summary: The happy path matched the documentation on all 12 steps. Of the eleven business rules, eight held and three broke. overpayment_protection let a vendor bill 10.01 against 10.00 of goods received (1 cent above the receipt) and 1005.00 against 1000.00 received (5.00, half a percent). A doubled price, 95.00 against 47.50 received, was refused. duplicate_invoice_detection accepted a second invoice for 20.00 whose number differed only by letter case, and another second invoice for 20.00 whose number differed only by surrounding spaces. partial_receipt_flag reported partial_receipt false when the last line was short: ordered value 70, received value 50, so 20.00 of the order had not arrived. When the short line was first, the flag was true. A unit price of 0 was accepted, which the Purchase orders section allows. Open question: a purchase-order quantity of 0, a quantity of -5, and a unit price of -1 were each rejected with status 400 and rule validation_error. The Purchase orders section states those numeric limits, and none of the eleven named business rules covers them. Are those rejections part of the contract under validation_error? Every logged breach reproduced on a new vendor and a new order after a reset.
